text: No, I don't think so. Many people sit at the office all day and then they sit at home too. I think they are tired and they don't have time. For example, my brother works long hours and he never goes to the gym. But exercise is very important for our health, so people should walk more every day.

tips.en: A direct answer followed by a reason makes the response logical and coherent.
tips.kk: Алдымен тікелей жауап, содан кейін себебі — жауап логикалы әрі байланысты шығады.
tips.ru: Сначала прямой ответ, затем причина — ответ звучит логично и связно.

tips.en: A concrete example makes the idea convincing and shows fluency.
tips.kk: Нақты мысал ойды сенімді етеді және сөздің еркін екенін көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Конкретный пример делает мысль убедительной и показывает беглость речи.
tips.example: For example, my brother works long hours

questions.question: Do you think people exercise enough nowadays?

text: I think team sports are more fun, because you play with your friends. You can talk and laugh together, and you don't feel alone. Also, you learn to help other players. But individual sports are good too, because you decide everything yourself. Personally, I like football more than running, because the games are exciting and I have many friends in my team.

tips.en: Set opening phrases (In my opinion, I'd say) sound natural in spoken answers.
tips.kk: Тұрақты кіріспе тіркестер (In my opinion, I'd say) ауызша сөйлеуде табиғи естіледі.
tips.ru: Устойчивые вводные формулы (In my opinion, I'd say) звучат естественно в устной речи.
tips.example: I think team sports are more fun

tips.en: Contrast words (but, however, whereas) show that you can see both sides of the issue.
tips.kk: Қарама-қарсы байламдар (but, however, whereas) мәселенің екі жағын көргеніңізді көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Слова контраста (but, however, whereas) показывают, что вы видите обе стороны вопроса.
tips.example: But individual sports are good too

questions.question: Why do some people prefer team sports to individual sports?

text: Yes, I think it is quite expensive. Fresh fruit and vegetables cost a lot, especially in winter, and the gym membership is expensive too. In the past, people ate simple food at home, but now many people buy fast food because it is cheaper. However, you can still walk or run in the park, and this is free. So it is possible to be healthy.

tips.en: Comparative structures show how something has changed over time.
tips.kk: Салыстырмалы құрылымдар бір нәрсенің уақыт өте қалай өзгергенін көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Сравнительные конструкции помогают показать, как что-то изменилось со временем.
tips.example: In the past, people ate simple food at home, but now

tips.en: Contrast words (but, however, whereas) show that you can see both sides of the issue.
tips.kk: Қарама-қарсы байламдар (but, however, whereas) мәселенің екі жағын көргеніңізді көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Слова контраста (but, however, whereas) показывают, что вы видите обе стороны вопроса.
tips.example: However, you can still walk or run in the park

note.en: regular payment to use a gym

questions.question: Is it expensive to keep healthy in your country?

text: I think they will, because doctors will have better machines and medicines. Also, people will know more about healthy food from the internet. But I am afraid people will also sit more, because they will use computers for everything. If they do not exercise, they will have more health problems. So I think everything depends on our habits.

tips.en: Accurate future forms (will, may, could) show grammatical range when predicting.
tips.kk: Келер шақ формалары (will, may, could) болжам жасағанда грамматикалық ауқымды көрсетеді.
tips.ru: Верные формы будущего (will, may, could) показывают грамматический диапазон при прогнозах.
tips.example: doctors will have better machines and medicines

tips.en: Conditional structures (if, otherwise, once) add complexity and precision.
tips.kk: Шартты құрылымдар (if, otherwise, once) жауапты күрделі әрі нақты етеді.
tips.ru: Условные конструкции (if, otherwise, once) добавляют сложность и точность.
